cold_logical_cache: Fresh Python process and fresh output manifests for every job; no logical-cache prewarming
failure_policy: Preserve all first logs; an incomplete four-job case has no timing comparison; no replacement or automatic retry
filesystem_cache: OS/page-cache coldness NOT CLAIMED; no cache eviction or settings change
interpretation: Same current frozen source in default-old versus opt-in cache mode; two prespecified reversed-order pairs per case. No area or broad runtime gain inferred.
memory: No transform-specific RSS claim; exact cache-owned descriptor counts/limits are retained in results
original_proof_identity: Unmodified saved job/source/CNF/model/receipt identities; variant implementation bound separately
source_artifact_identity: Default-off verified against pre-cache artifacts; current-default and current-opt-in ordered traces match
timing_boundary: Whole saved-worklist subprocess lifetime, including imports, source/evidence checks, full initialization, annotation/persist, original-model admission, exact CNF and witness replay, product/checkpoint and final guards, reloads/stat/descriptors/serialization, and shared semantic-oracle work. Per-job controller source verification and result validation also consume the cumulative case budget. Global preflight/final binding checks and process cleanup are separately reported. This is not pure-persist timing or an optimizer budget.
